authorship: Same implementation assistant authored questions and relevance labels after reading the corpus; no independent human author, blind review, or external benchmark.
split_policy: Fixed dev/heldout labels before first retrieval or live generation. Heldout denotes unseen evaluation inputs during this development run, not independent data provenance. Never relabel or replace failures after evaluation.
label_policy: Relevant document IDs are required evidence targets for the specific question. Recall scores measure recovery of these finite labels, not exhaustive semantic relevance. Multi-document questions require all listed targets. Historical evidence retains original version scope.
